title: Pay land tax on residential land
what: Pay land tax each quarter on rateable residential land the business owns in the ACT (the ACT taxes residential land, not commercial land).

sources.title: Land Tax Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 9(1) (current republication (R34, from 26 December 2025; Land Tax Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: (1) Land tax at the appropriate rate is imposed for a quarter on each parcel of rateable land that is residential land.

administration.who: ACT Revenue Office (Commissioner for ACT Revenue)

sources.title: Land Tax Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: dictionary, definition of commissioner (current republication (R34, from 26 December 2025; Land Tax Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: commissioner means the commissioner for revenue.

triggers.note: Each quarter, on rateable residential land owned on the first day of the quarter.

reach.condition: if it owns rateable residential land in the ACT
reach.note: Any business that owns taxable land in the state; exemptions (such as a home or primary production land) are not yet recorded.

sources.title: Land Tax Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 9(1) (current republication (R34, from 26 December 2025; Land Tax Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: (1) Land tax at the appropriate rate is imposed for a quarter on each parcel of rateable land that is residential land.

confidence_note: In the ACT, land tax applies to residential land only.

assessment.summary: An annual tax on the value of land owned, with exemptions and a tax-free threshold. A tax on land value distorts little in principle, but thresholds, exemptions and rates that rise with total holdings narrow the base and change who holds land and how.

marks.reason: Exemptions, thresholds and rates that rise with total holdings narrow the base and tax owners unevenly, so land use and ownership respond to the tax.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the tax's design against the framework's guide; the size of the effect varies by state and was not measured.
